senses.gloss: (denom. of גָּרוֹן, גַּרְגֶּרֶת) to pour down the throat, opp. שתה to set the lips to the vessel.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 9:4">Par. IX, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Parah 9:4">Tosef. ib. IX</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 8:6">VIII</cite>), 6.—*<cite ref="Gittin 89a:3">Gitt. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>גִּירְגְּרָה בשוק</he> if she quaffs outdoors; [Rashi: walks with outstretched neck (<cite ref="C01302"><he>גָּרוֹן</he></cite>)].

senses.gloss: denom. of גַּרְגַּר) to pick single berries.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 2:6">Maasr. II, 6</cite> <he>מְגַרְגֵּר ואוכל</he> he may pick grapes (from the hanging cluster) and eat; <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 3:9">ib. III, 9</cite>; Y. ib. II, 50ᵃ top.

senses.gloss: (denom. of גְּרוֹגֶרֶת) to let the olive shrivel (on the tree or in the sun on the roof), to mark out for shrivelling.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 36">Ex. R. s. 36</cite> that olive—while it is yet on its tree, <he>מְגַרְגְּרִין אותו</he> they mark it out for shrivelling (in order to use it for the press).

Men. VIII, 4 מְגַרְגְּרוֹ בראש הזית he lets it shrivel on the top of the olive tree; מג׳ בראש הגג in the sun on the roof; [for oth. opin. v. Rashi a. l.].—Ib. 86ᵃ מְגרְגְּרוֹ תנן או מְגַלְגְּלוֹ תנן does it read m’garg’ro (he lets it shrivel) or m’galg’lo (he lets it hang until it is fully rounded)?
